summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (3.84% of outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired up to ¥2.0B via open market purchase on TSE from 12 June 2026 to 30 November 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled effective 15 January 2027 (3.41% of pre-cancellation outstanding). Rationale: improve capital efficiency and expand shareholder profit distribution.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Terms for Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Determination of Terms for Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 11 June 2026, the board of CEC (シーイーシー, ticker 9692) resolved to acquire treasury shares and subsequently cancel them. The company will acquire up to 1,200,000 ordinary shares (3.84% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, which stood at 31,210,464 shares as of 30 April 2026) for a maximum aggregate ¥2.0 billion via open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from 12 June 2026 to 30 November 2026. All acquired shares will be cancelled, effective 15 January 2027, representing 3.41% of the pre-cancellation outstanding share count. The stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency and expand profit distribution to shareholders.
